comment: Rules of the veille réglementaire (ABClassement). A JORT text matches a rule when its sommaire title, without its issuer ('Arrêté du ministre de … du <date>,'), contains one of 'any' as whole words (accents and case ignored), and, when 'with' is given, also one of 'with'; 'institution' rules match the institution the text is listed under. 'references' cite a text the app is built on: critique. Other rules have a 'level': important (an obligation for establishments) or information (sector news). 'domain' and 'sectors' (sections of the nomenclature) say whom it concerns; 'impacts' names the parts of the app concerned; 'when' says to which sites a text found by the rule applies (conditions of lib/registre/profil.ts), so that it is proposed in their register (no 'when': added by hand only). Titles starting with one of 'ignore', or containing one of 'ignoreAnywhere', never match; a title containing one of 'demote' (international agreements, one-off acts) is information at most. After editing, run npm run veille -- --reassess.
